Tracing is now OpenTelemetry-only, and Traefik v3 drops direct output formats for Instana, Jaeger, Zipkin, Haystack, Datadog and Elastic. Operators must move to vendor OTLP endpoints or an OTel collector. The open aspect is applicability, and here the excerpt only names vendors in prose. It never gives the v2 configuration options (static config keys, CLI flags or env vars) that select these vendor tracing backends, so an engineer cannot write a declarative exposure condition from it. We need the v2 tracing configuration reference, or a v2-vs-v3 static config diff, that names those options.
